name: JNP Character Production Foundation
description: Reusable character-production gates for setup, SFF, AIR, movement, get-hits, sound, QA, and sign-off. Game policy enters through profiles and workflow blocks.

phases.name: 1. Character Setup
phases.summary: Establish native files and project ownership before production assets are measured.

steps.label: Character DEF and required native files resolve
Project naming and requirements profiles are selected
Local coordinates and character constants are reviewed
Production, unassigned, and archival ownership is clear

phases.name: 2. SFF Foundation
phases.summary: Create a stable uncropped, indexed sprite foundation before animation and state work expands.

steps.label: Character SFF is assigned and readable
Master palette is protected and the default palette is assigned
Required sprites and animations pass the project requirements audit
Feet, middle, and head axis references are present and reviewed
Unassigned, classified, layered, and archived sprites are reviewed
SFF validation has no unexplained errors

phases.name: 3. Basic Movement
phases.summary: Complete the movement and guard foundation needed for meaningful in-engine testing.

steps.label: Standing, turning, crouching, walking, jumping, and landing actions exist
Standing, crouching, and aerial guard animations are reviewed
Movement transitions use reviewed native or project-owned states
Movement Clsn2 and runtime size boxes are reviewed
Movement and guard behavior pass an in-engine test

phases.name: 4. Get-Hit Foundation
phases.summary: Make the character safe to strike, launch, knock down, and recover before move testing broadens.

steps.label: Required standing, crouching, aerial, fall, trip, and recovery actions exist
Guard reactions remain distinguishable from true hit reactions
Authored hit-region behavior and metadata are reviewed
No get-hit sequence contains an unexplained invisible frame
Ground, air, knockdown, trip, and recovery reactions pass testing
